query_1.procedure: Commit one page, retain full-query resume, then complete the same work. Estimate five pages, not a guaranteed bound.

query_2.procedure: Within the same authorized run, use a separately frozen later freshness/cutoff to force a re-observation of the same window. Keep both revisions; absence of a change proves only this sample.

deadline_note: Freeze both work deadlines before calls. Preserve longer server cooldowns and stop/defer when the bound cannot finish; HTTP I/O timeout is not a strict wall-time cancellation guarantee.
cache_checks: Repeat each completed exact query and run normalization twice; require zero extra HTTP attempts and zero duplicate normalized observations.
owner_binding: Reuse one stable private quota principal/root for all cooperating callers; never mint a new principal to obtain fresh allowance.
rights_prerequisite: Satisfied by owner-approved private-local operating interpretation; reopen only on decisive contrary evidence or expanded use.
storage: Private local storage/reuse authorized by the owner; raw observations and detailed reports outside Git. No automatic purge or externally shared data.
publish: Only separately reviewed nonsecret operational metadata may enter Git; no raw/reconstructable bars, account IDs, credentials or request tokens.
acceptance: All 30 scoped pairs, valid OHLC/volume/time fields, no unresolved quarantine, receipt/cutoff preserved, resume/cache/reingestion idempotent, actual attempts reconciled and cooldowns respected. Missing or incomplete evidence blocks qualification.
headroom_claim: This is a small workload check. Do not extrapolate tested capacity to 180 or 200 RPM or claim control over outside callers.
